name: FR-10 development documents: reference departments and tags, for the tag and department threshold (D-129)
status: APPROVED by the user as drafted on 13 November 2026, in a tabbed question (over a stricter one-value-each variant). FROZEN: committed before any classification call it is used with, and never edited after; a development set, never the frozen twenty (corpus/objective-05/reference.json).

scheme.note: The corpus scheme D-106's sweeps use, from corpus/objective-02/manifest.json.

how_to_read: For each document, the values that are right in each dimension. A suggestion counts as right when its value is in the list for its dimension, and wrong otherwise. An empty list means no scheme value fits that dimension, so any suggestion there is wrong. Where two values are defensible, both are listed. Only suggestions INSIDE the scheme are scored: a value outside it is discarded or proposed whatever its confidence, so the threshold does not decide it.
